outcome: baby admissions to progressive care unit
cohort: 60 pregnancies of 58 women with SCD (29 SCD-SS and 29 SCD-SC) compared with 192 pregnancies in 187 healthy pregnant women
finding: SCD pregnant women, especially those in the SS subgroup, are more prone to experience perinatal and maternal complications in comparison with pregnant women without SCD.
birth_weight: SS subgroup: 2080 g, SC subgroup: 2737 g, controls: 3035 g
